pricing.source: Official page https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read by the project on 2026-10-10 (base input/output tokens, global routing, no caching, no batch discount); the rate for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, which every FaultLab call is (32,000-token input bound)

claim: A development screen on newly drawn schedules of the same task. It tells whether Haiku's habits break on harder or different faults than the public cases; it is not an unseen-case test of any rule, and these cases become development evidence.
decision_rule: A case shows a repeated mistake when the same lowest failed check appears in at least 2 of its 3 trials. Any repeated mistake makes a repair study on that case worth proposing to the owner (a new draw would then be the unseen test); none means no repeated mistake was found on these cases, and it is reported that way.

draw.rule: each stratum shuffled by the seed text, taken in order while the September reference plays the case cleanly through the worker, fires every fault and keeps a turn

monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to this month's committed dollars plus the $0.50 hard cap

name: bookings-screen-2-2026-11-19
order: the first drawn case first (three trials, the preflight), then the other fifteen, three trials each: 48 trials in all

preflight.pass: all three executions COMPLETED with recorded dollars and under 80 seconds of wall time; every ledger row they added names the model; no answer reached 1,900 output tokens; mean cost under $0.03 a trial. A missing or invalid report is a finding, not a preflight failure. The preflight trials count as the case's three trials.

question: With Haiku 5.5 as pack-actor on 16 bookings cases drawn new from the September fault grammar (four per stratum: lost_create, move_trouble, hold_trouble, other), three trials each and no rule: which checks does it fail, and does any case show a repeated mistake (the same lowest failed check in at least 2 of its 3 trials)?
readouts: per case and stratum: the failed checks and the lowest failed check of each trial
the oracle's false beliefs by claim
stop_rules: a billing message in any log stops the run
the preflight must PASS before the other 45 trials run
the batch dollar caps ($0.1008 and $0.3992, $0.50 in all) and the process monthly cap refuse further calls
an INFRA_ERROR trial is reported, not retried
